comment: Both oscillators sound an octave above the figures in the code's comments and in the manual, because src/modules/Cowbell.hh:107 and :111 set the phase increment to frequency * rSampleRate * 2 while the square flips once per unit of phase at :61 and :66. The upper oscillator's frequency variable is 500 + control * 300 (:106) so it sounds 1000Hz to 1600Hz; the lower is that variable minus 260 (:110) so it sounds 520Hz below the upper, 480Hz to 1080Hz. The manual's 240-540Hz and 500-800Hz are the two variables, not what is heard. Only `phase` is reset on a trigger at :47; `phase_1` runs on undisturbed.
